deploy.// startCommand: Deliberately absent. Railway reads railway.json from the BUILD CONTEXT ROOT, which ADR-001 makes the repository root, not this directory — so a startCommand here is silently ignored. Migrations and the server therefore live in the Dockerfile CMD, where every platform sees them.
deploy.// healthcheckPath: /live, not /health. Railway restarts a container that fails its healthcheck, so pointing it at a check that includes Postgres turns a database blip into a restart loop. /health is for humans and dashboards.
